punchline: According to Adam Grant, the most successful givers help in batches, not in scattered bits, and keep the rest for their own work.
thirty_sec: Adam Grant says the giver who runs to every request ends up exhausted, useless to himself and to others. The most successful givers are generous but not naive. They give in batches, set aside part of the week for others and keep the rest for their own work, spot takers and say no when needed.
